info.name: Go Server: App API
info.description:
Everything the app can call on the Go Server. Import this file and the environment file into Postman.

**Quick start:** run *1. People, trips, joining > Create person* (saves `token`), then *Create trip* (saves `tripId`). Every other request uses `{{token}}` automatically.

Errors always look like `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`. Money is whole paise. Full reference: docs/API.md.

item.name: 2. Messages
item.description: Chat. Every post needs your own `client_id` so retries never post twice.

query.description: Return messages with updated_seq greater than this

request.description: Messages posted **or changed** after a change number, oldest change first. Page on: next `after_seq` = last message's `updated_seq`. A reaction without `person_id` is Go's. `author.kind:"go"` messages must look like Go, never a person.

request.description:
`client_id` is **required** (use a new UUID per press; the same id again returns the first answer). Send `text` (≤4000) and/or `attachments` (≤10).

- `reply_to`: message id being replied to.
- `about_message_id`: **"Ask Go about this"** (Go answers even if the text doesn't name Go).
- `mentions`: person ids (≤30).
- Attachments: `{kind:"photo",url,width?,height?,caption?}` or `{kind:"file",url,name,mime,size_bytes}` (URLs only, no upload yet).

The message counts as *for Go* when it has `@Go`, starts with "Go,", replies to Go, or has `about_message_id`.

**Saves `messageId`.**

item.name: 3. Votes, mandate, record, expenses
item.description: The Server's own buttons (record cards) and the calls that open votes and bookings. They never go to Go. `decisionId` comes from the trip data (`decisions[]`), the vote card, or is saved by *Open a vote* / *Propose cancelling a booking*; `bookingId` is saved by *Add booking* (or take one from `bookings[]`).

request.description: Any member opens a vote. Strict body: unknown fields, wrong types and `null` are `422`. `client_id`: a new one per press, the same one on a retry (a repeat returns the first answer). `options`: 2-10, each `label` (1-120, required), `image_url?` (URL: render only http/https), `price_minor?` (paise, shown in the trip's currency), `note?` (≤120). `closes_at?`: ISO time in the future. The server posts no vote card in the chat (Go does) and sends no push. **Saves `decisionId`.**

request.description: Any member adds a booking they made. Stored as confirmed in the trip's currency, with you as the person who added it. **Creates no expense.** `kind`: `stay | flight | train | bus | cab | table | activity | other`. `title` 1-120, `vendor` and `ref` 1-80, `amount_minor` ≥ 0 (paise), `for_person_ids` 1-30. request.description: Any member proposes cancelling a booking; the group decides. Opens a yes/no vote that is not anonymous and closes 24 hours later. The booking is cancelled only if "Cancel" gets MORE THAN HALF of everyone in the trip when the vote closes (people who do not vote count against; a tie does not cancel); otherwise it stands. Nothing is cancelled with the vendor. `404` not in this trip; `409` already cancelled, paid through Go's vault, or a cancellation vote is already open. **Saves `decisionId`.**

item.name: 4. Asking Go (via the Server)
item.description: Go may be slow or busy: show the error and let the person retry. **Never auto-retry.**

request.description:
For `options`, `working`, `call`, `pay`, `notice` cards only (record cards → 422). `tap_id`: your own id per press (a double tap with the same id counts once); new press = new id. `option_id` when the button was on one option.

Results: `done` (show toast) · `open` (open `url` in the **system browser sheet**, never a WebView; link expires in 5 min) · `refused` (show toast).

item.name: 6. Live connection (SSE)
item.description: Postman can open this but is awkward for streams; in the app use a streaming HTTP client.

request.description:
`text/event-stream`, with the `Authorization` header (browser `EventSource` can't send it). `: ping` every 20 s.

| event | data | do |
|---|---|---|
| `hello` | `{trip_id}` | connected |
| `message` | full Message | add/replace by `message_id` (also edits, deletes, reactions, **replaced cards**) |
| `trip` | `{seq}` | re-read the trip + needs-you if `seq` is higher than yours |
| `typing` | `{who, on, until?}` | show/hide "Go is typing..." |

After a reconnect, re-read messages (`after_seq`) and the trip.
